title: Adaptation of DNA to Protein Binding Revealed by Spectroscopy and Molecular Simulation.
authors: van Heesch, Thor; Sharma, Sudhanshu; van Erp, Bert; Ortiz, Alberto Perez de Alba; Dame, Remus T; Vreede, Jocelyne; Gavvala, Krishna
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文结合MD模拟与增强采样研究H-NS蛋白对AT富集DNA的序列特异性识别及诱导的DNA构象适应，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作机制建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: DNA demonstrates remarkable structural diversity, transitioning between conformations such as B-DNA and A-DNA under specific environmental or protein-binding conditions. These transitions are relevant for mediating cellular processes such as gene regulation, DNA organization, and stress response. In bacteria, the histone-like nucleoid structuring protein (H-NS) exemplifies the interaction between sequence-dependent DNA conformational adaptability and protein-mediated regulatory mechanisms. Despite evidence for the strong affinity of H-NS for AT-rich DNA, the specific molecular and structural interactions driving this recognition remain largely unclear. Combining fluorescence spectroscopy, circular dichroism (CD), molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and enhanced sampling techniques, we show that H-NS exhibits a 10-fold higher affinity for ApT repeats compared to that of GpC repeats. Interestingly, selective binding of H-NS to AT-rich DNA causes a structural adaptation in the DNA, including increased bending flexibility, minor groove widening, and localized A-like DNA features, while GC-rich DNA remains closer to the canonical B-form. Our approach yielded detailed insights into how H-NS exploits the intrinsic conformational plasticity of DNA to achieve sequence-dependent binding. More broadly, this work illustrates how DNA-binding proteins can harness the structural adaptability of the DNA double helix, which may modulate regulatory outcomes, and provides insight into how the intrinsic properties of DNA shape protein-DNA interactions in diverse biological systems.
abstract_zh: DNA展现出显著的结构多样性，在特定环境或蛋白质结合条件下，可在B-DNA和A-DNA等构象之间转换。这些转换与介导基因调控、DNA组织和应激反应等细胞过程相关。在细菌中，组蛋白样核仁结构蛋白（H-NS） exemplifies 了序列依赖性DNA构象适应性与蛋白质介导的调控机制之间的相互作用。尽管有证据表明H-NS对富含AT的DNA具有强亲和力，但驱动这种识别的具体分子和结构相互作用仍 largely 不清楚。结合荧光光谱、圆二色性（CD）、分子动力学（MD）模拟和增强采样技术，我们表明H-NS对ApT重复序列的亲和力比GpC重复序列高10倍。有趣的是，H-NS对富含AT的DNA的选择性结合导致DNA发生结构适应，包括弯曲灵活性增加、小沟加宽和局部A型DNA特征，而富含GC的DNA则更接近经典B型。我们的方法深入揭示了H-NS如何利用DNA的内在构象可塑性实现序列依赖性结合。更广泛地说，这项工作阐明了DNA结合蛋白如何利用DNA双螺旋的结构适应性，这可能调节调控结果，并提供了关于DNA内在特性如何在不同生物系统中塑造蛋白质-DNA相互作用的见解。
